subject.name: HRain / iNaiHR
subject.core_architecture: minimal human/BCI semantic primitive -> LLM semantic expansion -> persistent editable cognitive graph

hrain_working_mindmap.evidence: Initial uploaded implementation explicitly titled 'Hrain - Mind Map Tool' with node creation, connections, pan, zoom, resizing, deletion and localStorage persistence.

inaihr_initial_bci_claim.evidence: Initial README: 'Mind-mapping engine for Neuralink / BCI — turns 1 thought into full cognitive graph'.

inaihr_first_ai_graph_implementation.evidence: D3 force-directed graph plus AI Synth that expands a selected concept into generated related child concepts.

author_declared_design_origin.statement_normalized: The system was conceived as an assistive mind-map interface for people with severe motor impairments, including operation by eye gaze, with future direct BCI/implant control.
author_declared_design_origin.historical_public_evidence_boundary: The earliest public iNaiHR commit independently anchors the Neuralink/BCI intention. A specific eye-gaze statement was not found in the earliest searched Git commits, so eye-gaze origin is preserved here as an author declaration rather than retroactively asserted as Git-proven on 2025-11-28.
author_declared_design_origin.ar_boundary: The graph interaction model is spatial/AR-portable, but no WebXR/ARCore implementation was found in the currently inspected HRain/iNaiHR code; AR is therefore a design direction, not a completed historical prototype claim.

what_is_distinctive.not_just_ai_mindmap: The broad category AI+mind-map predates the project.
what_is_distinctive.not_just_bci_llm: LLM-assisted BCI spelling/prediction predates the project.
what_is_distinctive.candidate_delta: Use a low-bandwidth decoded semantic primitive as the seed of an expandable, persistent, editable concept graph rather than merely predicting the next letters/words of a sentence.
what_is_distinctive.human_in_loop: The user navigates, selects, edits, dives into and corrects generated branches; the LLM amplifies semantic bandwidth rather than replacing user intent.
what_is_distinctive.assistive_goal: Convert scarce eye-gaze/BCI selections into a richer navigable thought structure, reducing the number of low-bandwidth control actions required to express or explore an idea.

prior_art_matrix.boundary: AR mind maps are not claimed novel by HRain/iNaiHR

prior_art_matrix.work: Mappa Mundi: An Interactive Artistic Mind Map Generator with Artificial Imagination
prior_art_matrix.known_feature: AI-assisted mind map with automatic topic expansion
prior_art_matrix.boundary: The broad AI+mind-map combination is not claimed novel

prior_art_matrix.known_feature: P300 BCI plus GPT-3.5 word/sentence suggestions to reduce keystrokes
BCI spelling plus GPT-4o context-aware word and sentence prediction
EEG semantic anchors followed by LLM sentence reconstruction
prior_art_matrix.chronology_note: Published after iNaiHR's initial 2025-11-28 BCI semantic-graph commit; independent work, not evidence of copying.
prior_art_matrix.boundary: Shows later convergence on semantic compression/amplification as a response to low neural-signal bandwidth

novelty_assessment.candidate_claim: BCI-oriented semantic bandwidth amplification in which one decoded thought primitive is expanded by an LLM into a persistent editable cognitive graph.

safe_public_claims.short: In November 2025 I publicly built iNaiHR, a BCI-oriented mind-mapping interface designed to turn a minimal decoded thought into an LLM-expanded editable cognitive graph.
safe_public_claims.stronger_but_careful: My public Git history anchors the Neuralink/BCI -> one thought -> full cognitive graph concept to 28 November 2025. In the targeted comparison so far, I have not found an earlier exact match for this specific semantic-graph bandwidth-amplification architecture.
do_not_claim: validated 5-10x throughput without a controlled patient study
implemented eye tracking or AR in the earliest public build unless separately demonstrated

next_scientific_gate: formalize semantic bandwidth amplification metric: user intent bits / BCI actions / time
implement an eye-gaze adapter as a reproducible non-invasive accessibility input layer
run controlled comparison against conventional grid/speller and ordinary AI autocomplete
measure graph navigation cost, correction burden, semantic fidelity and task completion time
separate 2D graph core from optional WebXR renderer
broaden patent and HCI/BCI prior-art search for semantic graph expansion interfaces
